newsitem.title: USA: Icahn in talks with Natl Energy over Panaco.
newsitem.headline: Icahn in talks with Natl Energy over Panaco.

text.p: Investor Carl Icahn said Tuesday he has been in talks with Miles Bender, chief executive officer of National Energy Group, regarding the possibility of National Energy acquiring Panaco Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Icahn, who owns more than five percent of Panaco's outstanding common stock, said Bender expressed interest in having National Energy make such an acquisition.
Icahn, a major Wall Street player, said he also spoke to James Maxwell, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Panaco, as part of a three-way conversation with Bender.
At that time, Bender told Maxwell that National Energy would be interested in making such an acquisition on a friendly basis, according to the filing.
Icahn first spoke to Bender on June 12, the filing said.
Last November, National Energy acquired the Bayou Sorrel Field from Panaco for about $9 million. The field is located next to the C.E. Schwing #1 near Iberville Parish.
Maxwell told Icahn, while he is opposed to such a deal, he would discuss it with Panaco's board of directors, according a separate SEC filing made by Panaco.
Icahn also requested that Maxwell consider having two of Icahn's representatives sit on Panaco's Board of Directors.
Icahn also holds more than five percent of National Energy Group's outstanding equity.
